newsitem.title: USA: Universal Seismic group seeks new board.
newsitem.headline: Universal Seismic group seeks new board.

text.p: A group owning about 5 percent of Universal Seismic Associates Inc's common stock said Monday that it would seek to have the company's board replaced.

The group said it filed a preliminary consent and proxy statement with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission. It said it would conduct a consent and proxy solicitation of shareholders after it received SEC clearance.
The group said it was unhappy with the board's decision to end merger talks with Suelopetrol CA, a Venezeulan seismic contractor.

Universal Seismic signed a letter of intent in August to acquire Suelopetrol. Last month the company said the talks had ended because of an inability to resolve material business and due diligence issues.

The shareholder group, comprised of Michael Kanarellis of Houston and Robert Kecseg of Irving, Texas, said in a release that the company should finish its due diligence review and complete the merger.
